tested_standards: ISO 354:2003 (Acoustics — Measurement of sound absorption in a reverberation room)
ISO 11654:1997 (Acoustics — Sound absorbers for use in buildings — Rating)

triple_pinch_pleat.drape_profile: Traditional Haute Couture fluted columns. Triple fabric folds hand-pinched and stitched at heading base, allowing opulent, deep folds to billow gently down to the floor.
triple_pinch_pleat.astana_architectural_context: Recommended for master bedroom suites, formal dining rooms, and classical penthouses (ЖК Talan Towers, Sensata, Highvill). Eliminates light leakage between pinch tops and provides maximum thermal barrier against winter draft.

ripplefold_wave.heading_tape: Bandex Wave 77mm continuous carrier string tape (60mm/80mm snap spacing)
ripplefold_wave.drape_profile: Pure contemporary architectural rhythm. Continuous sinusoidal curves (S-fold) that appear identical from both interior and exterior vantage points. Compact stack-back width.
ripplefold_wave.astana_architectural_context: Essential for panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows up to 6.8m (second-light living rooms). Stacks neatly into corners without occluding panoramic city views over the Ishim River.

inverted_box_pleat.drape_profile: Flat front face with deep hidden inverted pleats on reverse. Modern, tailored, geometric silhouette.
inverted_box_pleat.astana_architectural_context: Ideal for executive home offices, diplomatic libraries, and contemporary minimalist interiors.

tailored_roman.name_ru: Дизайнерская римская штора с фибергласовыми ребрами
tailored_roman.drape_profile: Crisp horizontal cascade with concealed fiberglass rods and bottom counterweight bar.
tailored_roman.astana_architectural_context: For panoramic kitchen prep zones, master bathrooms with freestanding tubs, and compact guest bedrooms.

categories.name_ru: Бельгийский шенилл и тяжелые акустические полотна
categories.curatorial_mission: Engineered for acoustic reverberation dampening, luxury tactile weight, and thermal insulation against severe continental winter temperature differentials.

categories.name_ru: Итальянский натуральный лен фактурного плетения (300-330 см без швов)
categories.curatorial_mission: Spun from certified organic European flax for monumental panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows. Delivers diffused luminous light filtration without vertical seam interruption.

categories.name_en: French Silk Organza & Dedar Wild Silk Couture
categories.name_ru: Французская шелковая органза и дикий шелк Dedar Milano
categories.curatorial_mission: Uncompromising Haute Couture. Sourced from the historic silk looms of Lyon and Dedar Milano. Combines crisp sculptural memory, natural slubbed wild tussah sheen, and ethereal iridescent transparency.
categories.typical_weight_range_gsm: 40 - 240 g/m² (organza sheer to heavy wild silk dupioni)

categories.name_en: German Trevira CS Non-Flam Architectural Fabrics (B2B / Contract)
categories.name_ru: Негорючий архитектурный текстиль Trevira CS (Германия, КМ1 / B1 для B2B)
categories.curatorial_mission: Inherently flame-retardant phosphorus-modified polyester for luxury hotels, embassy residences, headquarters, and videoconference suites. Complies with Federal Law 123-FZ (KM1) and DIN 4102-B1.

categories.name_en: Haute Couture Cashmere, Damask & Blackout Essentials
categories.name_ru: Кутюрный кашемир, венецианский дамаск и светозащитные основы
categories.curatorial_mission: The crowning zenith of European textile arts: Loro Piana Interiors noble wools, Rubelli Venetian silk jacquards, and soft-touch satin blackout backings.

swatches.name_en: Wind Flanders 'Acoustic Grand' Heavy Chenille
swatches.name_ru: Бельгийский тяжелый шенилл Wind «Acoustic Grand»
swatches.composition: 62% Cotton Chenille, 26% Spun Viscose, 12% Highland Wool

triple_pinch.note: Creates majestic, architectural fluted columns with weighted hem puddling.

ripplefold.note: Requires minimum 16 cm clearance in ceiling niche due to dense yarn pile.

box_pleat.note: Strict tailored box pleats hold firm under fabric weight.

roman_shade.note: Superb acoustic Roman shade for private cinema and master bedroom.

swatches.drape_character: Heavy, sculptural, deep puddling drape with luxurious matte velvet luster and silent motion.
swatches.fire_rating: Class 1 Residential / Optional FR Salt Backcoating for KM2
ideal_applications: Master Bedroom acoustic sanctuaries in high-rise penthouses
Acoustic damping in high-ceiling living rooms (eliminates room echo)
Home theater blackout & sound absorption drapery
Thermal barrier curtains for panoramic northern elevations
swatches.care_maintenance: Dry clean only (Hydrocarbon solvent). Vertical micro-steam with Laurastar at 100°C without mechanical surface pressure.
swatches.curator_notes: The foundation fabric of Maison Poisson. Spun from ultra-soft Flemish chenille yarns with a wool core. In Astana's dry winters, this fabric grounds the room physically and acoustically, eliminating the hollow reverberation of bare concrete and monolithic glass.

swatches.name_en: Deltracon Flemish Heavy Bouclé-Chenille
swatches.name_ru: Фламандское букле-шенилл Deltracon «Havana Luxe»

triple_pinch.note: Massive tactile presence; crowns beautifully with hand-anchored triple pinch.

ripplefold.note: Use 80mm carrier spacing on heavy Somfy Glydea 60 motors.

box_pleat.note: Tailored couture look for libraries and study rooms.

roman_shade.note: Heavyweight roman shade with reinforced cross-rods.

swatches.drape_character: Substantial, three-dimensional tactile bouclé hand with soft woolly loft and grounded fall.
ideal_applications: Executive private study rooms and diplomatic salons
Luxury chalet and contemporary villa living halls
Acoustic dividing portieres between open-plan zones
swatches.care_maintenance: Delicate professional dry cleaning. Brush gently with natural horsehair textile brush to preserve bouclé loops.
swatches.curator_notes: Deltracon is legendary for combining coarse textural yarns with delicate softness. This fabric boasts the highest NRC coefficient in our residential portfolio (0.85), functioning as an invisible acoustic panel disguised as Haute Couture drapery.

swatches.name_en: Kortrijk Heritage Chenille-Velours
swatches.name_ru: Бельгийский шенилл-велюр Kortrijk «Heritage Royal»

triple_pinch.note: Unrivaled deep folds that mimic Parisian grand apartment draperies.

ripplefold.note: Smooth liquid ripples that shimmer subtly when electric light grazes the surface.

roman_shade.note: Best suited for grand vertical cascades rather than fold-ups.

swatches.drape_character: Silky-soft deep pile, heavy vertical cascade with rich light-trapping shadows and couture drape memory.
ideal_applications: Presidential master suites and luxury hotel suites
Grand neo-classical and art-deco architectural projects
Formal dining rooms and music salons with grand pianos
swatches.care_maintenance: Specialist velvet dry clean. Never apply direct iron flat; vertical steaming only with velvet brush head.
swatches.curator_notes: Woven in Kortrijk on traditional wire-loom double-plush machinery. The combination of cotton chenille and modal gives it an incandescent depth of color that responds magically to low evening chandelier lighting.

swatches.name_en: Brabant Ribbed Architectural Chenille
swatches.name_ru: Архитектурный рельефный шенилл Brabant «Cord Weave»

triple_pinch.note: Linear ribs align vertically with pleat fluting.

ripplefold.note: Vertical corded texture accentuates the cylindrical wave rhythm.

roman_shade.note: The horizontal cross-bars contrast crisply with vertical ribs.

swatches.drape_character: Structured vertical corded texture with supple pliable body and matte architectural relief.
ideal_applications: Contemporary penthouses with minimalist wood and travertine paneling
Executive home offices and high-end residential libraries
Bespoke roman shades in modern architectural kitchens
swatches.care_maintenance: Dry clean only. Steam in the direction of the vertical ribbing.
swatches.curator_notes: A favorite of Astana architects working on minimalist interior projects. The subtle ribbing breaks acoustic surface waves while giving modern rooms a sense of grounded stability.

swatches.name_en: Loro Piana Interiors 'Terra Altai' Textured Master Linen
swatches.name_ru: Итальянский органический лен Loro Piana Interiors «Terra Altai» (330 см)
swatches.composition: 100% Certified European Organic Flax (Masters of Linen)

ripplefold.note: Unrivaled continuous wave across 3.3m-6.5m panoramic heights without a single vertical seam.

triple_pinch.note: Tailored triple pinch creates crisp organic fluting.

roman_shade.note: Seamless wide Roman shades up to 3.2m width.

swatches.drape_character: Airy yet weighted organic drape with natural slub irregularity; cascades with effortless nonchalant Italian 'sprezzatura'.
swatches.fire_rating: Natural fiber class / Inherent low toxicity

colorways.name: Lino Greggio Naturale
colorways.finish: Raw unbleached linen with flax flecks

ideal_applications: Floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass facades in luxury penthouses (Sensata, Talan Towers)
Second-light double-height living halls (up to 6.8 meters high)
Organic minimalist villas and country residences (BI Village Deluxe)
swatches.care_maintenance: Delicate dry clean or gentle eco-clean. Pre-shrunk through mechanical water-bath finishing in Biella. Steam with Laurastar on medium setting.
swatches.curator_notes: Sourced from the historic Piedmont spinning mills of Loro Piana Interiors. The 330 cm extra-wide roll width allows Maison Poisson to fabricate 12-meter wide seamless panoramic curtains with zero joining seams. It filters the harsh sun into an incandescent, honeyed Mediterranean atmosphere.

swatches.name_en: C&C Milano 'Delavé Sabbia' Washed Slub Linen
swatches.name_ru: Итальянский умягченный лен C&C Milano «Delavé Sabbia» (310 см)

ripplefold.note: Fluid sinusoidal drape that moves gracefully with ambient indoor airflow.

triple_pinch.note: Relaxed European couture pinch.

roman_shade.note: Soft folds stack in relaxed, cloud-like horizontal clouds.

swatches.drape_character: Ultra-soft tumbling hand, enzyme-washed drape with relaxed organic memory and zero stiff crispness.
ideal_applications: Panoramic living rooms with south and south-west exposure
Master bedroom lounges combined with hidden Somfy blackout roller shades
Bespoke relaxed roman shades for designer kitchens
swatches.care_maintenance: Specialist dry cleaning recommended to retain exact dimensional stability. Can be lightly steamed on hang.
swatches.curator_notes: C&C Milano's enzyme delavé wash removes the rigid pectin from flax fibers, yielding a drape that feels as comforting as heirloom vintage linen yet retains the clean architectural lines demanded by modern architects.

swatches.name_en: Solbiati 'Brezza Grande' Open-Weave Architectural Sheer
swatches.name_ru: Итальянская панорамная вуаль Solbiati «Brezza Grande» (325 см)

ripplefold.note: Floats like mist along motorized Ripplefold tracks without waving or snagging.

triple_pinch.note: Delicate French triple pleats require lightweight Bandex sheer tape.

roman_shade.note: Translucent daylight roman shade.

swatches.drape_character: Airy, ethereal, luminous suspension; filters light with shimmering micro-reflections from the silk core.
ideal_applications: Daytime sheer layer for floor-to-ceiling panoramic penthouses
Softening high-altitude steppe glare while preserving panoramic skyline views
Dual-layer Somfy motorized curtain systems behind heavy night drapes
swatches.care_maintenance: Gentle hand-wash at 30°C in protective wash-bag or professional gentle dry cleaning. Do not tumble dry. Hang damp for self-relaxation.
swatches.curator_notes: Solbiati is considered the world's foremost authority on fine drapery linen. 'Brezza Grande' blends fine Italian flax with a 15% Mulberry silk filament for strength, creating a seamless 3.25m veil that dances with the light.

swatches.name_en: Casamance 'Linen Raw Structure' Heavy Organic Weave
swatches.name_ru: Европейский фактурный лен Casamance «Natura Raw» (300 см)

ripplefold.note: Holds crisp, rhythmic wave folds with excellent lateral recovery.

triple_pinch.note: Crisp tailored headers.

roman_shade.note: Structure gives razor-straight horizontal folds without sagging.

swatches.drape_character: Crisp organic body with textured slub cross-grain, balanced vertical drop, and tactile substance.
ideal_applications: Modern luxury apartments with Scandinavian or Japandi aesthetics
Bedrooms requiring gentle morning illumination without harsh blinding light
High-end Roman shades over marble island counters
swatches.care_maintenance: Professional dry clean. Cold steam with Laurastar.
swatches.curator_notes: Our top-volume European linen selection. It bridges the gap between high design and everyday functional durability, offering 300 cm seamless drop capability at an accessible luxury price point.

swatches.name_en: Bellagio Melange Slub Panoramic Linen
swatches.name_ru: Панорамный меланжевый лен Bellagio «Slub Melange» (320 см)

ripplefold.note: Two-tone melange yarns create dynamic depth as folds curve in and out.

triple_pinch.note: Refined bespoke look.

roman_shade.note: Smooth flat panels with slub visual interest.

swatches.drape_character: Textured melange slub with subtle tonal variations; supple drape with balanced gravitational pull.
ideal_applications: Panoramic floor-to-ceiling glass in master suites and penthouse living rooms
Villa sunrooms and glazed architectural corridors
Modern minimalist interiors where texture replaces printed pattern
swatches.care_maintenance: Dry clean only. Steam vertical without compression.
swatches.curator_notes: Woven with double-twisted melange yarns where raw linen is twisted alongside raw tussah silk. When sunlight strikes the window, the fabric produces an optical micro-depth that single-color fabrics cannot match.

swatches.name_en: Dedar Milano 'Splendido' Raw Wild Silk Dupioni
swatches.name_ru: Итальянский дикий шелк Dedar Milano «Splendido Dupioni»
swatches.blackout_classification: Dense Shading Silk (78% Alone / 100% with Cotton-Sateen Interlining)

triple_pinch.note: Holds crisp sculptural pinched pleats like an evening gown; creates royal floor puddling.

ripplefold.note: Must be backed with light interlining to maintain wave curvature.

roman_shade.note: Best deployed as full-length flowing drapery.

swatches.drape_character: Crisp architectural hand, structured memory, natural organic slubs with dual-tone iridescent luster.
swatches.fire_rating: Silk Natural Low Flame Spread / Can be FR treated
ideal_applications: Penthouses and VIP master bedrooms (e.g. ЖК Talan Towers, Sensata)
Formal state salons and ambassadorial reception chambers
Executive suites with integrated Somfy Glydea Ultra motorized whisper-tracks
swatches.care_maintenance: Strict specialist dry cleaning only (P solvent). Never spray water drops directly on raw silk. Protect from direct unshaded UV with interlining.
swatches.curator_notes: The crowning glory of Italian silk craftsmanship from Como. Dedar's 'Splendido' preserves the natural irregular slubs of wild tussah caterpillars. In our atelier, every silk drapery is lined with European cotton sateen to safeguard the delicate protein fibers against Astana's intense solar radiation, guaranteeing decades of royal beauty.

swatches.name_en: Dedar Milano 'Adamo & Eva' Cotton-Silk Haute Velvet
swatches.name_ru: Итальянский бархат Dedar Milano «Adamo & Eva Soft»

triple_pinch.note: Tailored French triple pleats form dramatic, deep light-absorbing valleys.

ripplefold.note: Fluid S-waves reflect velvet highlights smoothly across the room.

roman_shade.note: Folds may mark velvet pile over time.

swatches.drape_character: Sumptuous, ultra-dense plush pile with matte-silk depth, zero synthetic sheen, and liquid drape flow.
ideal_applications: Master bedrooms requiring acoustic serenity and light buffering
Opulent living room portieres and architectural dividers
Private cinema rooms and sound-insulated music studios
swatches.care_maintenance: Specialist velvet cleaner only. Store and transport hung in specialized tall wardrobe boxes to prevent pile pressure marking.
swatches.curator_notes: Adamo & Eva is Dedar's legendary signature cotton-silk velvet. Unlike cheap synthetic polyesters that shine harshly under LEDs, this fabric swallows light, creating an aura of supreme discretion and wealth.

swatches.name_en: Pierre Frey 'Organza de Lyon' 100% Crisp Silk Organza
swatches.name_ru: Лионская шелковая органза Pierre Frey «Organza de Lyon»
swatches.composition: 100% Natural Mulberry Silk (Pure Sericin Crisp Finish)

ripplefold.note: Airy waves with crisp architectural paper-like folds.

triple_pinch.note: Sharp, origami-like pleats that hold their form with zero sag.

roman_shade.note: Ultra-light translucent daytime roman shade.

swatches.drape_character: Crisp, airy, gossamer sheer with fine papery spring, crystalline transparency, and shimmering light diffraction.
ideal_applications: Daytime sheer drapes in luxury dressing suites and master bedrooms
Layering over French doors and private garden terraces
Under-curtain accompaniment to heavy Dedar silks and Belgian chenilles
swatches.care_maintenance: Ultra-delicate dry cleaning. Never wring or machine-wash. Steam lightly from a distance of 15 cm with Laurastar micro-vapor.
swatches.curator_notes: Woven on the historical heritage looms of Lyon, the capital of French silk since the Renaissance. Pierre Frey retains the natural sericin silk protein to give the organza its legendary 'crisp hand' (la main craquante), producing dramatic origami-like folds that float around windows.

swatches.name_en: Prelle Lyon 'L'Air du Temps' Silk-Linen Fil-Coupé Voile
swatches.name_ru: Французский шелковый филь-купе Prelle «L'Air du Temps»

triple_pinch.note: Displays the intricate clipped fil-coupé floating motifs across pleat crowns.

ripplefold.note: Fluid motion.

roman_shade.note: Stunning translucent Roman panel.

swatches.drape_character: Sensual, gossamer fil-coupé texture with cut-fringe yarn halos, floating motifs, and luminous transparency.

colorways.name: Ivoire Ancien
colorways.finish: Antique ivory with floating silk motifs

ideal_applications: Collector's salons and museum-grade residential living rooms
Haute Couture boudoirs and dressing salons
Bespoke embroidery-matched curtains for historic neoclassical villas
swatches.care_maintenance: Strict conservation-grade dry clean only. Protect from pet claws and direct heat sources.
swatches.curator_notes: Prelle is Lyon's oldest operating silk manufacture (established in 1752), weaver to the Palace of Versailles. Each meter of this fil-coupé voile involves manual shear-clipping of floating weft threads to create feather-like silk halos that catch the sunlight.

swatches.name_en: Dedar Milano 'Lucente' Metallic-Warp Wild Shantung
swatches.name_ru: Итальянский дикий шантунг Dedar Milano «Lucente Metallizzato»

triple_pinch.note: Sculptural metallic fluting catches ceiling spot lighting dramatically.

ripplefold.note: Smooth wave.

roman_shade.note: Statement Roman blinds.

swatches.drape_character: Crisp, architectural, tactile slubbed shantung with subtle metallic bronze glow that shifts with viewing angle.
ideal_applications: Penthouses with skyline night views (ЖК Talan Towers, Ray Residence)
Glamour dining rooms and private cocktail salons
Executive media rooms with mood lighting
swatches.care_maintenance: Specialist dry cleaning. Avoid heavy pressing; vertical steam only.
swatches.curator_notes: A dramatic showcase piece by Dedar that fuses ancient raw shantung slubs with ultra-fine bronze wire filaments. Under evening chandelier lighting, the drapery glows from within like molten metal.

swatches.name_en: Trevira CS 'Acoustic Forte' Heavy Dimout KM1
swatches.name_ru: Негорючий акустический димаут Trevira CS «Acoustic Forte» (КМ1, 310 см)
swatches.blackout_classification: Near-100% Dimout / Total Night Glare Shield

ripplefold.note: Flawless glide along automated Somfy Glydea Ultra motorized systems.

triple_pinch.note: Appropriate for ambassadorial residences and state conference rooms.

roman_shade.note: Acoustic conference room roman shade.

swatches.drape_character: Dense, supple, matte architectural drape with permanent acoustic micro-cavities and zero synthetic shine.
swatches.fire_rating: KM1 (123-FZ РФ / ЕАЭС: Г1, В1, Д2, Т2) • DIN 4102-B1 • NF P 92-507 M1 • EN 13773 Class 1
ideal_applications: Videoconference halls (ВКС) requiring zero echo and complete glare control
5-Star hotel guestrooms (St. Regis, Ritz-Carlton, Sheraton standards)
Embassies, ministry auditoriums, and state protocol chambers
Executive CEO boardrooms with panoramic glass facades
swatches.care_maintenance: Washable at 60°C in industrial laundering. Flame-retardant properties are molecularly bonded and cannot be washed out. Steam or iron up to 150°C.
swatches.curator_notes: The gold standard for commercial B2B architecture in Kazakhstan and the EAEU. Certified under Federal Law 123-FZ with Class KM1 fire rating, eliminating any inspection issues with fire marshals. Its NRC of 0.82 resolves the acoustic echo issues of large glass and marble conference rooms instantly.

swatches.name_en: Trevira CS 'Solar Screen 5% Horizon' Anti-Glare KM1
swatches.name_ru: Негорючий архитектурный скрин Somfy Screen 5% Trevira CS (КМ1)
swatches.composition: 64% Trevira CS Coated Fibers, 36% High-Tenacity Fiberglass Core
swatches.blackout_classification: 5% Openness Solar Glare Control (Filters 95% UV / Preserves View)

ripplefold.note: Primarily deployed on motorized roller screen tubes (Somfy Sonesse).

triple_pinch.note: Screen weave is best kept flat on tensioned rollers.

roman_shade.note: Ideal motorized Roman or Roller screen for open-plan offices.

swatches.drape_character: High-precision micro-perforated architectural grid; blocks solar heat and screen glare while maintaining clear exterior city vistas.

colorways.name: Anthracite Charcoal 5%
colorways.finish: Maximum contrast and optimum outward view

ideal_applications: Open-space corporate offices and IT company headquarters
Financial institutions and trading floors with intense monitor glare
Commercial tower atriums and southwest-facing panoramic facades
swatches.care_maintenance: Wipe clean with damp sponge and mild neutral soap. Antistatic, water-resistant, mold-resistant.
swatches.curator_notes: Engineered for modern glass skyscrapers where monitor glare paralyzes productivity. With 5% openness factor, staff can look out over the city while 95% of blinding solar radiation and heat is deflected.

swatches.name_en: Trevira CS 'Sanctuary 100% Contract Blackout 4-Pass' KM1
swatches.name_ru: Негорючий кассетный блэкаут 100% Trevira CS «Sanctuary» (КМ1)
swatches.composition: 100% Trevira CS Base with 4-Pass Acrylic Micro-Foam Blackout Coating
swatches.blackout_classification: True 100% Complete Total Blackout (0 Lux Transmission)

ripplefold.note: Provides seamless 100% darkness along ceiling tracks with zero needle-hole pinpricks.

triple_pinch.note: Classic hotel luxury.

roman_shade.note: Cassette system with side channels guarantees pitch-black darkness.

swatches.drape_character: Supple, soft-touch matte drapery with 100% opaque core, zero rubbery scent, and high dimensional stability.
ideal_applications: International business hotels where jet-lagged guests require pitch-black daylight sleeping
Executive multimedia boardrooms with 4K laser projection
Medical clinic VIP rest suites and diplomatic residences
swatches.care_maintenance: Delicate machine wash at 40°C or dry cleaning. Do not scrub backing foam. Steam with Laurastar from textile face side.
swatches.curator_notes: Unlike cheap commercial blackouts that use smelly PVC coatings that crack and release toxic fumes under heat, Sanctuary uses German 4-pass water-based acrylic foam bonded to Trevira CS. Certified odorless, toxicologically safe, and 100% light-impenetrable.

swatches.name_en: Trevira CS 'Lino Faux Contract' Textured Drapery KM1
swatches.name_ru: Негорючий фактурный лён Trevira CS «Lino Faux Contract» (КМ1, 305 см)

ripplefold.note: Imitates the organic beauty of Italian linen while satisfying strict fire marshals.

triple_pinch.note: Tailored executive look.

roman_shade.note: Clean, washable Roman shades for upscale hospitality.

swatches.drape_character: Natural slub-linen appearance with organic yarn thicks and thins, combined with indestructible contract durability.
ideal_applications: Boutique hotels and luxury serviced apartments
Upscale restaurants and private dining club rooms (HoReCa)
Commercial meeting rooms requiring residential warmth with commercial fire codes
swatches.care_maintenance: Fully washable at 60°C. Resists wrinkles, zero shrinkage (<0.5%), quick-dry.
swatches.curator_notes: Interior designers often lament that fire-retardant contract fabrics look cold and clinical. Lino Faux Contract solves this dilemma: it mimics the warm slubby texture of Italian linen so convincingly that guests cannot tell the difference, yet it withstands commercial laundering and strict fire inspections.

swatches.name_en: Trevira CS 'Aura Voile' Architectural Fireproof Sheer KM1
swatches.name_ru: Негорючая архитектурная вуаль Trevira CS «Aura Voile» (КМ1, 320 см)

ripplefold.note: Continuous fluid waves along double-track motorized hospital / hotel tracks.

triple_pinch.note: Neat tailored heading.

roman_shade.note: Daytime commercial privacy shade.

swatches.drape_character: Airy, soft, matte transparency; drapes with fluid grace and maintains dimensional stability in high-humidity zones.
ideal_applications: Contract hospitality window suites (5-star hotels)
Corporate headquarters and conference atrium facades
Embassies and consular reception halls
swatches.care_maintenance: Industrial washable at 60°C. Iron-free drip dry. Retains fireproof performance indefinitely.
swatches.curator_notes: A high-performance commercial sheer that delivers soft residential elegance while fulfilling all commercial fire codes. It features a built-in lead weighting band along the bottom edge for immediate, perfect vertical hang.

swatches.name_en: Loro Piana Interiors 'Zelander Drap' Cashmere-Wool Blend
swatches.name_ru: Кашемир и мериносовая шерсть Loro Piana Interiors «Zelander Drap»
swatches.composition: 70% Extra-Fine New Zealand Merino Wool, 30% Mongolian Cashmere

triple_pinch.note: Unsurpassed luxury; soft cashmere flutes puddling in deep folds on oak parquet.

ripplefold.note: Generous soft waves.

roman_shade.note: Too noble and voluminous for compact folding.

swatches.drape_character: Unrivaled soft warmth, cashmere caress, heavy fluid drape with quiet noble dignity and natural insulating thermal buffer.

colorways.name: Cashmere Vicuña Sable
colorways.finish: Iconic Loro Piana warm camel tone

ideal_applications: Presidential private master bedrooms and luxury dressing chambers
VIP penthouse lounges in Astana's most exclusive residences
Winter chalets and private family estates
swatches.care_maintenance: Specialist luxury dry clean only. Steam with Laurastar at gentle cashmere temperature without direct contact.
swatches.curator_notes: The ultimate textile indulgence. Woven from the finest New Zealand merino and Mongolian cashmere fibers. It creates a thermal envelope that protects the interior against -40°C winter winds while imparting the unmistakable quiet luxury of Loro Piana.

swatches.name_en: Rubelli Venezia 'Palazzo Gritti' Silk Jacquard Damask
swatches.name_ru: Венецианский шелковый дамаск Rubelli «Palazzo Gritti»

triple_pinch.note: Classic French triple pleats reveal the shifting relief of the historical damask pattern.
